C9000046.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 046 (Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group.; papers: A projective fourfold with large fundamental group and non-Stein universal cover; A surface counterexample to Shafarevich holomorphic convexity; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

S_DYADIC.statement: For every n=2^r with r>=2, the actual paired elliptic sphere family defined by [n] admits the quotient construction of prop:infinite-quotient: at t=49/200 any J>=2n with (1+6n^2)t(4t)^J/(1-4t)<1/100 imposes all D_J monodromy equalities, and the involution relations plus any subsequently chosen finite boundary-power family of cost <1/100 leave an infinite pro-2 quotient with dense fiber image.

S_TRIANGULAR.statement: For a free discrete group on a regular (Z/n)^2 orbit, the iterated translation differences delta_T1^i delta_T2^j(a_00), 0<=i,j<n, form a discrete free basis by a triangular word substitution, hence also a free pro-2 basis.

S_FINITE_ACTION.statement: For every dyadic n>=4 the actual joint marking/sign monodromy is (Z/n)^2 semidirect inversion C2, of order 2n^2; its mod-two group-algebra augmentation ideal has exact nilpotence index 2n, so D_(2n) kills this finite geometric action.

S_ACTUAL.statement: Actual corrected monodromies preserve the five explicit mod-two characters and change each weight-two pair boundary in degree at least three.

S_PINCH.statement: The actual based covering group surjects onto the sphere group; equivariant core collapse gives the exact pinching square and transfers equalizers without assuming a monodromy-invariant pinching kernel.

S_SHIFT.statement: Translation differences are a free basis and both translations and sign raise its weighted completed-algebra degree by one, including cyclic endpoints.

S_INVOLUTION.statement: The acyclic leading involution differential selects half as many relations as generators; these impose the full pro-2 involution, not just its Frattini action.

S_TRANSFER.statement: Operator substitution into the regular translation action transfers F-Magnus lower bounds to the L component of the based collapse map.

S_DEEP.statement: At most 4^N parameter representatives per layer, with all covering-group basis equalities, impose invariance under the entire closed deep parameter subgroup.

S_GS.statement: A locally finite countable pro-2 relator presentation with convergent negative weighted Golod-Shafarevich expression is infinite.

S_BOUNDARY.statement: A finite parameter cover has ramification index two at the distinguished degeneration; its meridians are killed, and finitely many other meridian powers can be added after compactification within the remaining weight budget.

S_QUOTIENT.statement: The manuscript's Q is infinite, every punctured fiber has dense image, all boundary meridians have finite image, and distinguished-fiber meridians are trivial.

S_LOCAL.statement: Finite detection of entire local boundary-group images lets the quotient map descend across normalization and all resolution meridians.

S_RATIONAL.statement: The distinguished reduced fiber on the final projective cover is a nodal union of smooth rational curves.

S_SPECIAL.statement: A connected component of the compact rational fiber has infinite image in the final surface group.

S_MAIN.statement: The surface manuscript's main theorem: a smooth projective surface contains a rational nodal curve of infinite fundamental-group image, producing a closed noncompact rational string in its universal cover and failure of holomorphic convexity.

S_HULL.statement: A compact connected nodal curve of smooth rational components with infinite fundamental-group image lifts to a closed noncompact rational string, on which every ambient holomorphic function is constant; its point hull is noncompact.

S_MERIDIAN_KERNEL.statement: For arbitrary groups and local subgroups detected injectively by a homomorphism, any set of meridians with local conjugate images killed by that homomorphism has normal closure in the original kernel; the original homomorphism descends to the quotient. This algebraic assertion does not encode the geometric hypotheses supplying those meridians.

S_DUAL_GRAPH.statement: The actual normalized distinguished fiber has coset-incidence graph with main vertices P, tail vertices disjoint union P/<a_j>, edges (p,j), component count [P:<a_j for all j>], and first Betti number |P|(k-1)-sum_j |P|/ord(a_j)+[P:<a_j for all j>].

S_SURFACE_DYADIC.statement: For every reviewed dyadic multiplication degree n>=4 the actual surface construction produces a smooth connected projective surface with a compact rational nodal curve of infinite fundamental-group image and a closed noncompact rational string in its universal cover, so the cover is not holomorphically convex; the distinguished fiber also has the explicit coset-incidence graph.

F_GEOMETRY.statement: Arithmetic orbifold geometry realizes the specified arrangements and a map from a blowup of a simple abelian surface.

F_MODELS.statement: Local model translation kernels are compatible and the projected-diameter graphs satisfy the required uniform hyperbolicity bounds.

F_PATH.statement: The local path criterion detects a nontrivial translation after imposing true orbifold relations.

F_IMAGE.statement: Comparison, cyclic upper bounds, and the surviving translation give an infinite cyclic image of the blown-up abelian surface in the orbifold group.

F_CYCLIC.statement: Projective ambient realization and repeated ambient blowdown embed a simple abelian surface with infinite cyclic fundamental-group image.

F_LARGE.statement: Interpolation, Bertini and Lefschetz turn the cyclic embedding into a large-group projective fourfold; the rank-three kernel obstructs a Stein universal cover.

F_MAIN.statement: The fourfold manuscript's main theorem: a large-group smooth projective fourfold has no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvarieties in its universal cover, which is nevertheless non-Stein.

F_COMPACT.statement: For a smooth projective variety, largeness of its fundamental group is equivalent to absence of positive-dimensional compact analytic subvarieties in its universal cover.

F046_SEPARATE_MERIDIAN_CROSSING_DETECTIO.statement: In OpenAI Family 046 (Shafarevich surface counterexample), detecting the image of each cyclic meridian separately in a finite quotient suffices to detect the full local boundary group at a normal-crossing point.
